meta.title: Withdrawing with blank remarks is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer withdraws the event with the remarks left blank.
As the buyer, read the event and check that “status” equals active.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “status” equals active.
